Designing and operationalizing of a blended circular economy investment instrument in the selected ASEAN countries. The project ideation call with MFA Finland is planned ion 3 November 2021 with a tentative plan for GGGI to produce project Concept Note in January 2021. The earlier start of the project would be Q3/2022.
